purpose: Unblinded character-only calibration diagnostics, not merge results or preference labels

inspection.media: All 16 generated clips inspected through 4 fps diagnostic contact sheets; three samples per creator reference
inspection.sheet_padding: Last four tiles are black padding, not video frames
inspection.limits: Sparse visual inspection cannot establish full temporal or audiovisual quality; observations are not independent human labels. Both characters and seeds are calibration, not held out.

technical_outcome.timing_limits: History execution intervals with uncontrolled caching, not end-to-end wall time or a merge-mode speed comparison

observations.comparison: The character adapter produces fur, short curved horns, broad muzzle and nose closer to the creator reference than either generic-monster base output in the inspected samples.
caveats: The adapter also changes the doorway/background toward a bright window-lit room; whole-frame similarity would mix identity with scene changes.

Seed 2026090822 character starts with the face largely outside the crop or hidden by the door in the earliest sampled frames; retain and report visibility, do not remove those frames to improve identity scores.
Green/purple fur is explicitly requested by the preserved creator prompt; canonical blue is not the target for this case.

observations.comparison: The character adapter produces facial appearance and long loose hair closer to the fictional creator reference on both seeds; the broad cafe setting remains recognizable.
caveats: The adapter changes crop, clothing and background details. Seed 21 uses a white top with dark outer layer; seed 22 a white sleeveless top. Base outfits and framing differ.
Creator reference used Turbo and post-processing whereas local qualification did not; this is not an exact reproduction.

observations.comparison: Character appearance remains recognizably closer to the Sully reference across sampled frontal and turned views on both seeds. The base produces a long-horned, tusked, bearded generic monster.
caveats: Head-turn and return are visible in sampled sequences, but shoulders/body also move and seed 21 reaches a stronger profile than the requested three-quarter view.
Pose adherence and identity must be separate judgments; a recognizable face is not proof of exact motion control.

observations.comparison: Character facial appearance stays closer to the fictional source through sampled head-turn and return views on both seeds, with long black hair and a white blouse.
caveats: Seed 21 begins somewhat three-quarter rather than strictly frontal; standing is not established by the crop and a chair back is visible in the base.
Seed 22 base and character turn toward opposite screen sides. Do not assume same-seed frames have corresponding poses or silently mirror them for an identity score.

decision.status: Both adapters are usable exploratory character controls, with visibility and pose caveats retained
decision.next: Freeze a separate character-plus-effect merge experiment, including each adapter alone and explicit stable/experimental methods; evaluate identity retention and second-concept success separately
not_established: Justification to change autotuner ranking or production defaults
